newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian lawmakers repeal marriage-after-rape law.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian lawmakers repeal marriage-after-rape law.

text.p: The Peruvian Congress voted on Thursday to repeal a law dating from 1924 that allows rapists to go free if they marry their victims, legislators said.

The bill, strongly supported by local women's groups, passed by an overwhelming margin after hours of debate in the 120-member unicameral body. Congress' Justice Committee voted unanimously last month to eliminate the article in Peru's penal code.
Similar laws are on the books in other Latin American countries.
